entries.claim: Network Slimming uses channel-level sparsity to identify and remove unimportant channels from CNNs
entries.notes: Structured channel removal changes tensor shapes; unstructured zeros do not guarantee speedup on dense kernels.

entries.claim: Deep Compression combines pruning, trained quantization and Huffman coding as a model storage compression pipeline
entries.notes: Reported compression ratios are specific to the evaluated AlexNet/VGG-16 configurations and are not generalized.

entries.claim: Knowledge distillation uses softened teacher probabilities at temperature T and T² gradient scaling when combining soft and hard targets
entries.notes: The code example is a deterministic objective sanity check, not a trained student benchmark.

entries.claim: PyTorch quantization development is moving toward torchao PT2E; older eager and FX quantization flows are recommended to migrate
entries.locator: PT2E quick start; PyTorch quantization migration note
entries.notes: Backend support and API maturity are version-dependent; check the exact installed torchao release.

entries.claim: The current PyTorch ONNX exporter recommends the torch.export-based dynamo=True path and dynamic_shapes for dynamic dimensions
entries.notes: Export success does not guarantee target runtime operator coverage or numerical parity.

entries.claim: TensorRT 11.x requires strongly typed networks and removes weak typing and implicit quantization; explicit Q/DQ expresses quantization
entries.locator: Strongly Typed Networks Are Now Required
entries.notes: Do not copy TensorRT 10.x implicit INT8 flag examples into a TensorRT 11.x workflow.

entries.claim: TensorRT dynamic-shape optimization profiles define min, opt and max dimensions for runtime input shapes
entries.notes: Only shapes within configured profile bounds are valid; benchmark the actual production shape distribution.
